status: completed exploratory configuration search; fixed T1 has highest three-seed test mean within the frozen matched comparison
objective: mean smooth bounded cross-entropy + eta_channel * theorem1_channel_complexity + eta_data * theorem1_sample_complexity

replication.checkpoint_selection: maximum two-draw validation accuracy within 25 epochs, tie broken by smaller validation cross-entropy

network_split.description: Tx: Conv3->16(3x3,pad1)/ReLU/MaxPool2; Conv16->32(3x3,pad1)/ReLU/MaxPool2; Conv32->64(3x3,pad1)/ReLU; AdaptiveAvgPool4x4; Conv64->8(1x1)/ReLU; spatial projection; 128 channel symbols. Rx: reshape (8, 4, 4); Conv8->64(3x3,pad1)/ReLU; flatten1024; Affine1024->128/ReLU; Affine128->10.

selection_rule: Among groups with proposed-minus-best-baseline validation accuracy >=0.005, maximize absolute proposed validation accuracy; CE then group name break ties
limitations: The reported winner is descriptive. T2 was the validation-prespecified primary and did not beat the baselines on the fresh-seed test mean.
Three seeds describe initialization and channel-bank variation on one reused fixed data split; they do not establish a statistically reliable population improvement.
T1 did not beat both baselines in every seed. No seeds were omitted and no per-seed objective switching was used.
The search selected a favorable architecture for within-architecture algorithm comparison; this is not the largest absolute accuracy across every architecture tried.
The change adds a transmitter convolution and a nonnegative spatial bottleneck as well as changing posterior-scale optimization. It is not a controlled relocation of the split point alone.
All methods use the same 128 real channel symbols and the same channel law, but transmit feature powers are unconstrained and differ. This is not an equal-power communication benchmark.
Finite-test accuracy and bounded-risk estimates do not establish tightness of the generalization bound.
The comparison fixes a 25-epoch training budget; T1 selected checkpoints at epochs25/25/24, so this is not a demonstration of converged baseline optimality.
